title: Scans: `last_updated` changes on status polls and chat messages, not only on real changes
body:
**Severity:** medium. "Last updated" and "Updated today" mislead customers: they move when nothing changed.

**Root cause.** Every list-page load re-polls each pending or started scan (`utilities/db/functions.py:105-106`), and the poll writes `last_updated = now` even when the status did not change (`celery_connection.py:200`). Sending a chat message to a scan also sets it, for a scan in any status (`routers/scans.py:216`).

**Expected.** `last_updated` changes only when the scan's state or results change (status transition, results written, rename). Chat activity, if worth showing, gets its own field.

**Fix.** Write `last_updated` only on a real transition; drop the chat write. Tests: a list-page load with an unchanged pending scan leaves `last_updated` unchanged; a status transition updates it.

Found by the content-accuracy review of PR #38 (review 5858670025). Evidence scripts: session scratchpad `round6/rv-content38-probe/`.
